collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager who believes in nothing unseen is asked to lead the harvest thanks: lead it their own way, or let a believer lead.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) brought in the biggest harvest this year, and by custom the best farmer leads the harvest thanks. But (subject) believes in nothing unseen, and does not want to thank spirits. (friend), who believes, says the thanks could be to the soil and the rain and the farmers instead. What should happen?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) leads the thanks: to the soil, the rain, the farmers, the cooks, and the goats for not eating the beans. The believers add their own prayers quietly. Everyone feels thanked. It becomes the new way.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) asks (friend) to lead instead, and stands with the farmers. The prayers are said. (subject) does not join, and nobody asks (subject.him/her) to. Afterwards, (friend) thanks (subject) for the harvest, personally.
